explanation: A subquery over UNNEST(event_params) reads one parameter per event and gives a missing value where the key is not there, so every page_view keeps its row. The cross join with a key filter is the tempting one, but it is an inner join: a page_view with no page_location has no row to keep. Without the key filter each page_view repeats once per parameter, and page_location is text, so its int_value slot is always missing.
